mapper.select: select (case when job = 1 then '班主任' when job = 2 then '讲师' when job = 3 then '学工主管' when job = 4 then '教研主管' when job = 5 then '咨询师' else '其他' end) pos, count(*) num from emp group by job order by num;
select if(emp.gender=1,'男性员工','女性员工')name,count(*)value from emp group by gender;

select (case when student.degree =1 then'初中' when student.degree =2 then '高中' when student.degree =3 then'大专' when student.degree = 4 then '本科' when student.degree = 5 then '硕士' when student.degree =6 then '博士' else '其他' end) name , count( *) value from student group by degree order by value;
SELECT c.name AS Name, COUNT(s.id) AS Num FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON c.id = s.clazz_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY Num DESC
